content.short: Transient is the premier NFT innovation platform for web3 creators, projects, and ecosystems.
content.description: Transient aims to simplify life for Web3 creators by offering practical tools that require no advanced technical know-how. With The Lab, artists can deploy smart contracts, mint NFTs, and craft interactive art projects from a user-friendly interface. The platform also supports ERC-7160 for multi-piece works and T.R.A.C.E. for authenticating physical artwork on-chain. By extending access to blockchain technology and smart contracts, Transient seeks to redefine ownership in the digital era while unlocking new creative potential.
